## Earnie 2.5.0-alpha.6

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5** line (follow-up to `2.5.0-alpha.5`). Focus: hourly EPEX settlement for aWATTar HOURLY/SUNNY, tariff catalog `settlement_mtu`, analog Zähler consumers, SE plausibility vs ESS standby.

### Highlights

- **Hourly EPEX settlement** — aWATTar HOURLY / SUNNY Spot (`settlement_mtu: "60min"`) bill the SDAC average of four QH prices, not each quarter separately (Live and SE)
- **Tariff catalog** — every `spot_hourly` id now has an explicit `settlement_mtu` + citation; no silent 15‑min default
- **Zähler-wired consumers** — live/log `signal_type: power` when a power meter is bound (no more 0/nominal binary rounding)
- **SE plausibility** — peel ESS standby from optimized baseload before the consumption check; Energy-Charts first for native QH prices
- **Docs** — English filenames for Loxone signals, abbreviations, config overview; EHAL-Com kept bilingual-aligned

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.0-alpha.6` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.4.0**).
